Name: SCIE-Port 移植集合 (Audit Build)
Description: Authorized SCIE port for SCNET x25.01.17. v0.28.1 fixes the V3.2 startup failure by assigning Skywrath network events the unique package ID 243; vehicle activation remains on 242. V3.2 provides two Android HUD skills, authoritative split melee damage, controlled five-point lightning retaliation, target-locked ultimate sequencing, layered avatar/weapon glow and high/medium/low VFX budgets. The original Stormhammer and all vehicle features remain unchanged. Android rendering, touch layout, combat values and real multiplayer synchronization remain pending device verification.
